LC copy imperfect: Halved and lower edge torn and pieces missing.
Publication statement: Indianapolis, Ind., Granger, Davis & co., 1880.

Published as the United States entered its second century (1880), the map and chart depict the growth and complexity of political parties from 1789-1880 as they related to national events and political issues. The text and charts provide statistical data, derived from federal sources that include revenue, expenditures, and other economic segments. The map also allows a comparison of Electoral College votes and the power of individual state legislatures.
